title: Connected learning universe: games, galaxy, journeys and growth
summary: Connect the existing emerald Academy with playable practice, evidence-based skill paths, tailored lesson routes and a richer review experience.

changes.detail: Nine playable activity modes with bounded deterministic number/JavaScript challenges, answer keys, scoring, feedback and saved runs. Practice scores do not award lesson mastery.
Knowledge Galaxy uses real course lessons and declared prerequisites; growth aggregates recorded recall, practice and project outcomes.
Seven saved journey choices change lesson-step order and reflection or deliverable prompts; existing lesson completion gates remain.

Dashboard mission connects to the next lesson; home, explorer and learning pages link the universe. Memory Studio adds due estimates, difficult collection, session progress and reduced-motion-aware card transitions.

validation.name: Work in progress
validation.detail: Initial typecheck found typing issues now being corrected. Full regression, multilingual browser, responsive and navigation validation pending. No deployment or native-device verification.
